example_rule: Choose a pooled eligible dense head matching inverse-distance criteria; prioritize number of matching individual texts, then closeness of alpha to1. Exploratory illustration, not independent confirmation.

protocol.data: Same four separate ~2k-token prose excerpts used in uniform99 gallery. Every model run reevaluated; predictions and loss match prior dense/uniform99 baselines.
protocol.query_control: Last128 scored queries per text, positionsN−129..N−2. Every query has every tested age available; no prefix key lies inside the fitted age range.
protocol.range: Seven complete bins8–15,16–31,32–63,64–127,128–255,256–511,512–1023. Self and very nearest tokens excluded; far edge beyond1023 excluded to keep full octaves and equal exposure.
protocol.fit: OLS of log(mean attention per available key) vs log geometric mean token age in each bin. Mean per-key weight=bin attention mass/(queries * number of keys per bin). w(d) proportional d^(−alpha). alpha1 corresponds approximately equal mass per doubling of distance; alpha0 is flat weight per key. R² measures fit in log space, not causal variance explained.
protocol.criteria: Descriptive approximate1/d: at least1% of head attention mass lies in8..1023, all7bins positive, alpha in[.8,1.2], log-spaceR²>=.8. Thresholds chosen before inspecting fits; not a formal statistical power-law test.
protocol.modes: dense: native model attention. uniform99: all heads/layers keep99% mass and propagate modified outputs; measured selected weights BEFORE final restricted-softmax renormalization, matching previous plot. Dense is the primary test to avoid trimming creating an apparent law.
protocol.limits: Averages over four texts and128late queries per text. Head means can conceal query-dependent patterns; per-query fit counts supplied. No general1/d law inferred from pooled fit alone.
protocol.old_plot_check: All-query pooled histograms additionally fitted after division by available query-key counts in each bin; this corrects unequal exposure but does not match query context lengths, hence secondary only.

additional_illustrative_head.selection: Chosen after full scan as an illustration with substantial mass in fitted range and approximate1/d in all four texts; exploratory, not held-out confirmation.
